infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Psych.ai requires Face ID to securely authenticate clinicians and unlock the HIPAA patient diagnostic vault.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Psych.ai requires camera access to capture clinical session video for facial biomarker analysis.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Psych.ai requires microphone access to capture clinical audio for vocal acoustic analysis.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Psych.ai requires photo library access to upload patient session recordings.
